_comment: Capability ids the capability handshake grants for ordinary account chat on the web surface with sandboxes deployed and selective connectors enabled, as apps/web/lib/prompts/product-capability-facts.ts returns them. The chat-prompt corpus renders the product capabilities section from these; apps/web/lib/prompts/__tests__/product-capability-facts.test.ts fails when they drift from the product. This does not enable connectors for artifacts or other full-release contexts.
